warnings: THIS SHEET IS THE PRINTED-DIMENSION SOURCE FOR EVERY DUMMY GRID LINE: top chain 1.00|9.60(3.20x3)|1.00 fixes 1'/4'; sub-chains 1.90|1.30 (bay 1-2) and 1.30|1.90 (bay 3-4) fix 2'/3' (the WC.1/WC.2 partition lines); 3.10 above grid E fixes F' (kitchen south wall line); left chain 14.55 (3.15|1.80|3.60|2.00|4.00) matches S-02 exactly and adds 1.60 south of A (carport strip). Both overall chains close (9.60 / 14.55).

Room label format on this sheet is [box]=floor material no., +x.xx=level, (oval)=finish/wall set no. -- the legend lives on A-01/A-02 (Stage 2); the three marks are transcribed verbatim as floor_mark/level_m/finish_mark without interpreting them.

BOTH bathroom porch bays print the same room name 'ห้องน้ำ 1' (west and east) -- recorded as printed with (ตะวันตก)/(ตะวันออก) disambiguators in element_id. The interior bathrooms are identified only by their callouts WC1 -> A-10 and WC2 -> A-12 (their enlarged plans A-11/A-12/A-13 are Stage 2 sheets; Stage 3 checklist #3 applies to any dimensions deferred there).

Opening inventory (window hexagons 1-2, door circles 1-3) was read at 2.6x; positions are approximate (~grid) and a few marks did not resolve -- counts here are floors, not ceilings. A-09 (แบบขยายประตู-หน้าต่าง) is the authoritative schedule; Stage 2/3 must cross the plan marks against it both ways (checklist #6).

Wall-type tags (paired bowtie triangles 1|1, 1|2 and single triangles 1/2 on wall faces) are printed all over the plan; they were NOT transcribed per-wall at Stage 1 -- they belong with the A-02 material legend in Stage 2. Nothing else on the sheet was left unread: stairs, benches, section cuts, แนวหลังคา (roof outline dash-dot rectangle) and the ±0.00 ramp are all recorded.

No drawing break lines on this sheet -- checked at ~4.5x on the row-C south wall band and the full-height grid-1 west wall (see grid master). The 0.45 partition (ห้องนอน 3 west wall) and the 1.90/1.30 partitions confirm as walls over beams only where S-04 draws beams; the 0.45 line has no beam and correctly got no dummy grid.
